message:
I drafted Plan A. It's a draft only, and I haven't saved or registered anything.

Plan A (13 credits):
- CS3650 Computer Systems §01 (CRN 91010): Tue/Thu 9:50–11:30 AM
- CS3651 Lab §01 (CRN 91020): Fri 9:00–10:40 AM
- ENGW3302 Advanced Writing for CS (CRN 91030): Mon/Wed 10:30–11:50 AM. This is your protected section.
- PSYC1101 Foundations of Psychology (CRN 91040): Tue/Thu 3:50–5:30 PM

The draft meets your requirements and credit range (12–18), has no work conflicts, and has no rule errors.

Tradeoff: it doesn't meet your Tue/Thu noon preference. CS3650 §01 meets Tuesday and Thursday at 9:50 AM. Here is why I couldn't avoid that:
- CS3650 §02 (91011) meets Tue/Thu 2:00–3:40 PM, but it requires lab §02 (91021) on Wed 12:00–1:10 PM. That overlaps your Wednesday work shift, which starts at 1:00 PM, by 10 minutes.
- CS3650 Honors §03 (91012) meets Tue/Thu 12:00–1:40 PM. It requires MATH2800, which isn't on your completed list, so you aren't eligible.

CS3650 and CS3651 are both required, so there's no way to drop CS3650 to avoid the morning meeting.

Your options:
1. Keep Plan A as drafted, with the 9:50 AM Tue/Thu class.
2. Switch to CS3650 §02 plus lab §02. That gives you no Tue/Thu morning classes, but the lab overlaps your work shift by 10 minutes. You could ask your employer whether you can start 10 minutes late on Wednesdays.

Which would you like? I can draft option 2 as a comparison without saving anything.
